basic.name: Groundbreaker
basic.description: Deal 81~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are Stunned for 0.5 seconds and then Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

basic.name: Bloodthirst
basic.description: Deal 156~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.

basic.name: Wrecking Ball
basic.description: Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing 91~~0.04~~ damage to enemies near the impact and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

heroic.name: Warlord's Challenge
heroic.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Decimate
heroic.description:
Deal 50~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.

Stores up to 3 charges.

trait.name: Armor Up
trait.description: Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing.

trait.name: Double Up
trait.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 5 seconds.

activable.name: Into the Fray
activable.description:
Activate to throw a nearby ally and grant them 20 Armor for 3 seconds. Deals 91~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies upon impact and Slows them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

While in flight, allied Heroes are Unstoppable.

activable.name: Body Check
activable.description: Activate to deal 111~~0.04~~ damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

activable.name: Indomitable
activable.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level1.name: Warbreaker
level1.description:
Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.

Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165~~0.04~~ damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.

Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

level1.name: Unrivaled Strength
level1.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 75%.

level1.name: Body Check
level1.description: Activate to deal 111~~0.04~~ damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

level4.name: In For the Kill
level4.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 100%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

level4.name: Thirst for Battle
level4.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

level4.name: Indomitable
level4.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level7.name: Intimidation
level7.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Oppressor
level7.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level7.name: Lok-tar ogar!
level7.description: Increase Into the Fray's Armor by 20. Hitting enemy Heroes with Into the Fray reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

level10.name: Warlord's Challenge
level10.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

level10.name: Decimate
level10.description:
Deal 50~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.

Stores up to 3 charges.

level13.name: Defensive Measures
level13.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350~~0.04~~ Shield for 6 seconds.

level13.name: Bloodcraze
level13.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 4 seconds.

level13.name: Double Up
level13.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Mortal Combo
level16.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

level16.name: Earthshaker
level16.description: Wrecking Ball Stuns enemies near the impact area for 0.5 seconds.

level16.name: Seasoned Soldier
level16.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

level20.name: Death Wish
level20.description: Increase the duration of Warlord's Challenge by 0.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is killed while Taunted by Warlord's Challenge, its cooldown is reduced by 45 seconds.

level20.name: Deadly Calm
level20.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Titanic Might
level20.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

level20.name: Inner Rage
level20.description: Body Check gains an additional charge and its healing reduction is increased by an additional 45%.
